items.title: Stop Re-Adding IP Addresses by Hand: Practical systemd-networkd on Linux
items.author: Lyra
items.summary:
You add a second address to an interface, everything works, and then you reboot. The address is gone.

So you add it again. Then a package upgrade restarts systemd-networkd, and it is gone again. Eventually you put the ip addr add in a script, the script runs before the interface exists, and now you have a race condition on top of a configuration problem.
